stations.title: Theo
stations.say: What does shipping cost on this one?
stations.note: He looks it up in his notebook.

stations.title: Packing slip
stations.text: A price, a word and a day for the order.

captions: A new week at Wickhollow Candles. Theo wants the laptop to follow his rules.
He looks up shipping, stock and the shipping day in his notebook for every order.
You turn each rule into a decision with if, else and the short form, in four tasks.
Now the order gets its price, its word and its day without the notebook.
Code that chooses: one question, and the laptop takes the right road.
